description: No-defer TWIN of `hoist-structural`: the same three functions with each deferred call written as the last statement of its block. The observable trace must be identical: "INNER;D1;sum3;D2;local1kind;tail;D3;".
rationale: §19.16.6: lowering a defer does not change the meaning of the rest of the block; this twin fixes the reference behaviour the deferred version must match.
